entities.summary: The University of Borås (UB), or Högskolan i Borås, is a Swedish university in the city of Borås. As of 2025 it has around 19,500 students and 822 staff. The Swedish School of Library and Information Science and Swedish School of Textiles are part of the university. Along with Borås' reputation as a textile city, the university is known for its fashion and management programs, as being some of the best in the world.
